prompts: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE 4:5 portrait Instagram campaign photograph, D-3 detail teaser for Havehad City Worker Club Jacket. Input 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, Paris Elysees dark silhouette teaser; do not reproduce its perfume, typography, logo, or layout. Shoot an intimate dramatic macro crop of the actual jacket's lapel, shoulder, top button and cotton stitching, with most of the garment disappearing into a physically dark charcoal-navy studio. A thin soft sidelight reveals olive-brown material and precise seams. Photographic editorial fashion campaign, elegant restrained urban uniform aesthetic, visible tactile cotton, rich shadows with clear selected detail, realistic fabric. Product-only, no human, no perfume. The jacket must match input 1 exactly, not leather or shiny fabric. No added text, dates, prices, claims, or watermarks. A single finished photograph, no mockup, borders, collage or layout sheet.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE 4:5 portrait Instagram launch-day product reveal photograph for Havehad City Worker Club Jacket. Input 1 is the exact real product, preserve ash-brown/olive matte cotton, three dark front buttons, notch lapels, lower flap patch pockets, little welt pocket above the left-of-image lower pocket, chest embroidery, silhouette and original label. Input 2 is STYLE ONLY: Rhode's sculptural fabric and soft light highlighting a hero product. Translate this concept into refined apparel photography without cosmetics or copying its text. Show the full exact jacket arranged naturally front-up on generously folded warm stone/taupe cotton backdrop; sculptural cloth drapes around it but never covers its construction. Soft directional morning studio light across fabric, natural shadow pockets, rich ash-brown neutral palette, restrained urban workwear editorial. Jacket fills about 78% of frame with breathable margins, sleeves entirely visible, tactile cotton rather than satin, subtle realistic folds. This is the bright reveal following a dark teaser. No invented accessories or people, no typography, release date, price, discount or watermark. One finished photo, no collage or mockup.
